source.title: Washington State Department of Revenue: Property tax
Washington State Department of Revenue: Property tax

rows.label: Constitutional rate limit
rows.value: Regular (non-voted) combined rate limited to 1% of market value ($10 per $1,000)
rows.note: Voter-approved special levies are on top of this limit.

source.title: Washington State Department of Revenue: Homeowner's Guide to Property Tax (June 2023)

rows.label: Levy growth limit
rows.value: 1% a year increase in each taxing district's regular levy (excluding new construction)
rows.note: Applies to the district's total levy, not to individual property values.

source.title: Washington State Department of Revenue: Homeowner's Guide to Property Tax (June 2023)
